biotools.summary: MCGAE is a deep computational framework for spatial transcriptomics data analysis, designed to create multi-view representations from gene expression and spatial adjacency matrices. It demonstrates improved performance in spatial domain detection, data denoising, trajectory inference, and 3D feature extraction.
